outcome: Accuracy of prenatal ultrasound in diagnosing UCK
cohort: 56 pregnant women with suspected UCK on ultrasound and 224 pregnant women without UCK
finding: Prenatal ultrasound demonstrated a high detection rate for umbilical cord knots, and with careful pregnancy follow-up and early term delivery, excellent obstetrical outcomes were observed in pregnancies with UCK.
gest_age: 22.1 ± 3.1 weeks at diagnosis of UCK, 37.1 weeks at delivery in the UCK group
birth_weight: No difference in birthweight percentile between groups
